title: Observability Response Conduit with smart playbook suggestions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a lightweight middle-tier ("Response Conduit") that sits between our telemetry pipelines and incident tools (PagerDuty/Slack). The Conduit will: 1) enrich incoming alert webhooks with compact trace and log slices pulled from a short-lived micro-collector, 2) compute a similarity score against historical incidents and return top-3 playbook suggestions, and 3) inject action buttons into Slack incidents for fast evidence attach / postmortem seed / safe rollback commands. Goal is to reduce mean time to context (MTTC) for oncall and accelerate postmortem creation while keeping PII exposure and webhook latency within acceptable bounds.
acceptance_criteria: PD webhook enrichment attaches a trace snippet and key-span summary for >=80% of sampled incidents in staging
Slack incident message renders actionable buttons and suggested playbook list within 5s of alert creation
Auto-generated postmortem draft includes timeline, top hypotheses, and linked PRs for at least 60% of incidents in the pilot cohort
No sensitive customer PII is included in attachments; passes privacy review checklist
End-to-end e2e test coverage and PD sandbox runbook demonstrates rollback command executes safely in staging
implementation_steps: Design Conduit API schema for enrichment payloads (fields: incident_id, trace_snippet, log_excerpt, similarity_scores, suggested_playbooks)
Implement trace micro-collector: ephemeral sampler that pulls spans + KV cache context for a given request id/range
Build similarity scorer service using embeddings of prior incident fingerprints and cosine similarity
Create Slack formatter that produces interactive message blocks with action handlers routed back to the Conduit
Integrate with PagerDuty webhook pipeline as an optional enrichment hook with fallthrough to original PD payload
Add privacy filters and redaction rules (configurable per-customer) before any enrichment is attached
Write integration tests against PD sandbox and Slack test workspace; run chaos scenarios to validate graceful degradation
Pilot with two product teams, collect metrics, iterate on playbook ranking model
dependencies: infra-logging: access to short-term log retention APIs
security: privacy/redaction patterns and KMS access for attachments
comments: 2026-02-28 - Aisha Kapoor: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed to adopt a narrow-first approach (trace snippets <=200 spans). Priority is low-latency and privacy-first. Marco assigned as eng lead.

2026-03-03 - Marco Reyes: Spike completed for micro-collector. Early numbers: fetching 200-span snippets adds ~120ms median overhead when run synchronously; plan to test async enrichment and PD webhook async callback path.

2026-03-05 - Security review (Sara Lund): flagged potential PII leakage in stacktrace lines and customer identifiers. Action: add redaction rules and customer opt-out config. Marked security_review_required=true
2026-03-07 - Design feedback (Eve Chen): Slack UX should prioritize one-click evidence attach vs bulk attach. Will prototype 3 button variants in staging channel.
2026-03-09 - Data Science (Ravi Patel): similarity scorer POC using embeddings + locality-sensitive hashing returned top-3 playbooks with 68% precision on pilot set; target >=75% before GA.
2026-03-11 - Marco Reyes: Implemented async enrichment flow: PD accepts alert, Conduit returns immediately; enrichment appended via PD note webhook within 2s. Integration tests added in PR #7834.

2026-03-12 - QA (Leah Morris): ran PD sandbox end-to-end; observed one failure where enrichment omitted log_excerpt for large incidents due to retention TTL. Follow-up: fallback to condensed metadata and schedule retrieval fix with infra-logging.
Next steps: complete privacy filters, improve similarity scorer precision, schedule pilot rollout with Payments and Search teams, and prepare runbook templates for suggested playbook UI.
notes: Trade-offs considered: synchronous enrichment simplifies UX but increases PD webhook latency and risk of dropped alerts; async append pattern chosen as default with config knob for teams that prefer synchronous attachments. We will rate-limit micro-collector and expose failure telemetry to avoid cascading ops costs.
qa_plan: Create PD sandbox incidents across severity P0-P3 and verify enrichment attachments and Slack actions
Introduce synthetic high-volume alert stream to validate rate-limiting and graceful degradation
Validate redaction rules against sample customer traces and perform manual review
